metadata.title: Collections
metadata.description: Organize company knowledge into curated collections for retrieval, graph exploration, and agent answers. Published collections can be discovered by other users in Marketplace.

collection_flow_title: Collections stay connected to chat and graph workflows
collection_flow_description: Create a collection, tune its indexing capabilities, then upload documents from the collection detail page.
empty_description: Create your first collection to organize documents, build retrieval indexes, and prepare knowledge for agents.
no_filter_results_description: Try another search term or switch filters to view more collections.
new_collection_card_description: Set up retrieval and graph capabilities before uploading documents.
general_description: Name the collection and set the language used for generated titles and document processing.
delete_collection_confirm: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete collection and remove your documents from our servers.
publish_collection_description: Allow users to discover and subscribe to your collection.
unpublish_collection_description: Remove the collection from the marketplace, making it private.
name: Name
description_auto_generated_placeholder: No description yet — auto-generated once documents are uploaded.
description_auto_generated_hint: Description is auto-generated by the system from the collection content. Click the button below to refresh it on demand.
summary_auto_generated_placeholder: No detailed summary yet — auto-generated once documents are uploaded.
summary_auto_generated_hint: The detailed knowledge-base summary is auto-generated by the system (~3000-7000 words), used by retrieval and agent exploration. Click the button below to refresh it on demand.
index_types_description: Select the AI capabilities you need. ApeRAG will build the corresponding indexes when documents are uploaded.

index_type_VECTOR.title: Vector
index_type_VECTOR.description: Represents data (text, images, etc.) as high-dimensional vectors to enable similarity-based retrieval.

index_type_FULLTEXT.title: Fulltext
index_type_FULLTEXT.description: Indexes keywords within text using techniques like inverted indexing for exact or fuzzy search.

index_type_GRAPH.title: Graph
index_type_GRAPH.description: Stores data as entities and relationships, enabling graph exploration and relational retrieval.

index_type_SUMMARY.title: Summary
index_type_SUMMARY.description: Indexes summaries or metadata of long documents instead of raw content for faster review.

index_type_VISION.title: Vision
index_type_VISION.description: Encodes visual content (images/videos) into feature vectors for content-based retrieval.

model_settings_description: Select AI models for document processing. Different index types require different model support.
embedding_model_description: An embedding model translates data into numerical vectors that capture their semantic meaning and relationships.
embedding_model_locked_description: The embedding model cannot be changed after the collection is created, because different embedding models produce incompatible vectors. Create a new collection if you need a different model.
completion_model_description: A completion model is an AI that generates new content by predicting the most likely subsequent text based on a given input.
export_knowledge_base_confirm_content: This will package all contents of this knowledge base from object storage, including original files, parsed artifacts, chunk data, and images.
export_knowledge_base_completed_descript: File size: {size}. The file will be automatically deleted after 7 days.
export_knowledge_base_failed_description: An error occurred during export. Please try again.
export_knowledge_base_too_many_tasks: An export task is already in progress. Please wait for it to complete.
export_knowledge_base_link_expired: The export link has expired. Please export again.
